metadata.title: fix(skill): force single recommendation in pr-review
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- The pr-review skill's recommendation section used checkboxes (`- [ ]`) for all three options, causing the reviewer to list all three instead of selecting one
- Replaced with `Pick exactly ONE: ...` directive to make selection unambiguous

## Test plan

- [ ] Run `/pr-review` on a feature branch and verify only one recommendation is output

reviews.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
reviews.body: ## Pull request overview Updates the `pr-review` skill’s output template to prevent ambiguous multi-selection in the “Recommendation” section by replacing checkbox options with an explicit “Pick exactly ONE” directive. **Changes:** - Removed the three checkbox recommendation options in the output template. - Added a single-line directive instructing the reviewer to choose exactly one recommendation. --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews. Learn how to get started.

commits.message:
fix(skill): force single recommendation selection in pr-review output

The pr-review skill template listed all three recommendation options as
checkboxes, causing reviewers to echo all three instead of picking one.
Replace the checkbox list with an explicit "Pick exactly ONE" directive.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer
